title: A very vivid dream I had recently in some sort of large resort/town
content: Sorry in advance for the long post, but I just discovered this sub, and after reading several threads, I noticed some similarities to a very vivid dream I had recently. Parts of this post/video especially: https://www.reddit.com/r/TheMallWorld/comments/wae3rm/an_in_depth_explanation_of_my_previous_beach/. The dream even had a weird start to it because I had already been awake for a couple of hours - I woke up early and tired but couldn't get back to sleep, so I eventually got up to make coffee. Before I could start the coffeemaker, I got overwhelmed with exhaustion and a sense that I had to go back to bed right away. It was strange, but I knew I needed more sleep, so I went back to bed and fell asleep almost immediately (which is extremely rare for me). In the beginning of the dream, I'm at a restaurant/bar sitting outside on a deck at a big wooden table under an umbrella having tropical drinks with some of my closest friends - friends I've had for decades. It's a beautiful day outside, and we're near the beach. There may have been a boardwalk outside the restaurant as well, but I'm not sure. We then leave and take a short Uber ride of maybe 10 minutes or so. The Uber drops us off at the entrance of what appears to be some sort of enclosed town or resort, which is unlike anywhere I've been before. There aren't any buildings directly around us, but there are long roads or walking paths in front of us that lead straight toward the main area with the rest of the town/resort, which is a little ways off in the distance. It looks like there are no cars from here onward though - just people walking, and there's some sort of monorail/train station. We get on the monorail and take a short ride to the main resort area. When we get out, we agree we're all going to head back to our individual rooms and then meet up later for pizza (but not until 11pm for some reason, which I thought was weird both in the dream and afterward). There are several buildings, each with several elevator banks, so we split into smaller groups and head our separate ways back to our individual buildings, elevators, and rooms. I'm not sure if this is a hotel and resort that we're all staying at, or if this is a town where we live. I'm with just one of my friends at this point, and we head into the building where we think our rooms are. It's a massive complex, and the entire sprawling first level is a giant casino/arcade/resort, though I remember thinking it was somewhat of a cramped design, or maybe they just crammed too much stuff in there. There are lots of little shops, tons of casino games and video poker/slot machines, and a big arcade with all kinds of stuff. There were lots of people around. At one point, there was a batting cage (baseball/softball), and I almost took a bat to the face had I not ducked away from the girl's swing in time. I remember thinking that they really shouldn't have a batting cage right inside next to the casino and basketball arcade games a few feet away. We keep walking through all of this until we find what we think is our elevator bank. At this point I realize I'm not really sure where my room is, but I think it's on an upper floor. My friend gets off at his floor, and I stay on the elevator to keep going up. Once the elevator doors close, it turns into a monorail cab, but it acts more like a roller coaster. There are a few people I don't know who are on there with me, and this thing takes off at a really high speed going through twists and turns around the huge resort/town just like a roller coaster track - it's even outdoors and looks like a roller coaster track, but I'm still inside what looks like a monorail cab (like in an airport train where everyone's standing). I don't remember much of what I saw outside other than lots of green space, and I think there were some pools or fountains. It was still a beautiful sunny day out. After a few minutes, the roller coaster/monorail/elevator brings me to my building and floor. I'm back inside what appears to be a standard elevator again, so I step off and onto my floor. It's a pretty drab/nondescript floor, and it's somewhat poorly lit. I'm still not sure if this is a hotel I'm staying at or an apartment building where I live. The doors to the rooms look more like an older NYC apartment (or what one looks like in my mind) - thin, off-white doors with standard gold door knobs, and they look kind of old but not rundown. I open a door and go into my room. I don't remember much other than it looking like a pretty standard hotel room with the drapes mostly closed so it's pretty dark inside. That's the last thing I remember before I woke up. It was really vivid and stuck with me pretty clearly. I had the feeling that it was much more real than a normal dream, and I had the urge to ask my friends if they had a similar dream at all, but I held off on that. Sorry for the long post, but if you made it this far, thanks for reading about my beach/resort/town/casino/arcade/amusement park/monorail/hotel/apartment adventure. Has anyone been somewhere similar?
